The hi-vis vest, work badge, and laptop being taken early in the morning and returned in the afternoon provide further evidence.

Minimalist routine with consistent work and meal patterns — The consistent placement of items (keys on entry hook, laptop at desk) suggests a well-established routine, though this is less specific than the early shift worker hypothesis and is contradicted by the specialized work equipment.
